description.en: When someone replies in a thread Locum opened: reacts, judges the outcome, queues the reply, resolves the thread only when fixed or accepted, and proposes the team decision to memory, also in the queue.
description.pt-BR: Quando alguém responde numa thread que o Locum abriu: reage, avalia o desfecho, deixa a resposta na fila, resolve a thread só em fixed ou accepted e propõe à memória a decisão do time, também na fila.

steps.name: Avaliar a resposta
